title: Rav Rechumi (II)

paragraphs: He was the student of Ravina (Rav Ashi’s colleague), as in [Zevachim 77a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.77a.5-6), where he sat before Ravina and was saying in the name of Rav Huna bar Tachlifa — Ravina said to him, “Torah, Torah.” In [Chullin 89a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.89a.14) he raised an objection to Ravina; in [Yoma 78a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.78a.4) he said, “I saw Ravina cross [the water] while wearing [his footwear].”

Hyman identifies this Rav Rechumi as the one who headed the academy after Rafram in Pumbedita, from the year 754 until 757 or 760, as stated explicitly in the [Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon](https://www.sefaria.org/Epistle_of_Rav_Sherira_Gaon.1.109).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Epistle names Richumai or Nichumai after Rafram, who died in 754, and gives 760 for Richumai’s death. Hyman also reports 757. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3227&lang=en) combines notices that Hyman assigns to different bearers of the name.
